versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Financial Due Diligence skill.
- Generates a tailored due diligence checklist, analytical questions, and red flags checklist based on transaction type and stage.
- Provides a document request list covering financial statements, revenue, costs, cash/debt, and tax matters.
- Offers a summary assessment template for quick RAG (Red/Amber/Green) evaluation of financial health.
- Includes best practice quality checks, anti-pattern warnings, and an advisory disclaimer.
